points.description: Correct final answer of 16 hours, supported by valid working (slow-lane speed is half of 60 = 30 miles/hour, then time = 480 ÷ 30 = 16 hours); equivalent wording and correct alternative methods earn the mark.

rubric.notes: Full marks require a correct final answer of 16 hours reached through mathematically valid steps. Any wrong step or wrong final answer earns nothing, since the single mark is all-or-nothing.
